definitions.explanation: remembering something incorrectly; a mistaken recollection

examples.japanese: それは{私|わたし}の{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いだった。
{約束|やくそく}の{日|ひ}を{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いしていた。
examples.english: I had misremembered the date of the appointment.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{名前|なまえ}は{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いでなければ{田中|たなか}さんだったはずだ。
examples.english: If I'm not misremembering, his name should have been Tanaka.

notes:
Composed of {記憶|きおく} (memory) + {違|ちが}い (difference/mistake). Specifically means remembering facts incorrectly — the memory itself is wrong, not that you forgot.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いだった: it was a faulty memory
- {記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いでなければ: if I'm not misremembering
- {記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いをする: to misremember

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勘違|かんちが}い: misunderstanding, misconception (broader — covers misunderstanding in general)
- {思|おも}い{違|ちが}い: mistaken thought, wrong assumption
- ど{忘|わす}れ: sudden memory lapse (tip-of-the-tongue — you know it but can't recall)
- {物忘|ものわす}れ: forgetfulness (general tendency, often associated with aging)

USAGE:
{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}い is relatively neutral and non-blaming. It acknowledges that memory can be unreliable without implying negligence.
